note: Entrance of the walled fountain garden, seen from the open iron double gate on the Place du Village (looking north). See sectors/S01/B01_PLAN.md. Top-hat fountain in the round court, stone arch with the name board behind it (rose garden beyond), white domed tea pavilion back left, pond and puppet theatre back right, farewell corner with the small iron farewell gate in the east wall on the right. Ring: R_greet > R_polite > R_exclaim_01 > R_exclaim_02 > R_exclaim_03 > R_farewell > farewell gate > Place du Village.
